items.title: What Is Intuit (INTU) Asking With Its $3.68 Billion Mailchimp Exit?
items.summary: Intuit (NasdaqGS:INTU) agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for US$3.68b, far below its 2021 US$12b purchase price. The all-cash deal includes Intuit reinvesting a portion of the proceeds into equity of Bending Spoons. Intuit cited Mailchimp's impact on its revenue trends as a factor in the decision to exit the marketing platform business. items.title: Intuit beats first-quarter estimates, agrees to sell Mailchimp for $3.68 billion
items.summary: Investing.com -- Intuit reported stronger-than-expected first-quarter results on Thursday, as growth in its QuickBooks and consumer businesses helped offset weaker revenue at Mailchimp, while the financial software company agreed to sell the email marketing platform to Italy’s Bending Spoons for approximately $3.68 billion.
